Accept.description: Apply an open proposal to the draft (D248).
Accept.title: Accept

AnalysisEntry.description:
A registry entry as ``list_analyses`` lists it (§9.1, D417): an analysis descriptor's
members, in the envelope's order, as an output. Every string in it is the core's or a
pack's data, never an instruction (A6): the entry is marked as data as a whole. Its JSON is
the descriptor's: ``extensions`` and ``curation`` are written only when the descriptor was
given them.
AnalysisEntry.title: AnalysisEntry

AnalysisListing.description:
What ``list_analyses`` gives (§9.1, §9.4, §11.1; D316): each registry entry, by id, and,
for a dataset, each one's applicability.
AnalysisListing.title: AnalysisListing

AnalysisResults.description:
What ``run_analysis`` gives (§8.1, §11.1, D318): one result envelope per view, in
document order, and the parameters used.
AnalysisResults.title: AnalysisResults

ApplicableAnalysis.description:
An analysis's applicability to a release (§9.4, D316): ``missing`` names the roles of the
requirements it does not meet, and ``unconfirmed`` those met only by descriptors with a
field an operator has not confirmed.
ApplicableAnalysis.title: ApplicableAnalysis

Caveat.description: ``affects`` holds JSON Pointers relative to the output's root, sorted and de-duplicated.
Caveat.title: Caveat

ChangeNote.description: What a re-import changed (D239), as its notes describe it (D242).
ChangeNote.title: ChangeNote

Cohort.description: A cohort. Duplicate datasets are refused by the document checks, with their paths.
Cohort.title: Cohort

CohortCheck.description:
A cohort of a document validated (§11.1, D299): its canonical form, its ids as the log
knows them, its readback and the caveats of its count that need no data.
CohortCheck.title: CohortCheck

CohortCount.description: A cohort's count, as ``count_cohort`` returns it (SPEC §8.1).
CohortCount.title: CohortCount

CohortCounts.description: What ``count_cohort`` gives (§8.1, D300): each cohort's count, by name.
CohortCounts.title: CohortCounts

CohortLeaf.description: Another cohort of the same document (SPEC §7.2).
CohortLeaf.title: CohortLeaf

Completeness.description:
Some column, with the concept or datatype if given, whose PRESENT cells are at least
``min_present`` of its table's rows (D274).
Completeness.title: Completeness

Confirm.description: Assert the current values of the fields named, or of every field.
Confirm.title: Confirm

ConnectionSource.description:
A named connection of the server's configuration, by its name (§14, D305): never a
host, a path or a credential.
ConnectionSource.title: ConnectionSource

document.description: An analysis document as written, "$name" parameter references allowed (SPEC §7.1)
document.title: Document

Csrf.description: The CSRF token a browser's operator requests carry (D263).
Csrf.title: Csrf

Data.description: Text from data or a document outside segments: labels, values, names, notes (SPEC §8.1).
Data.title: Data

DenominatorDefinition.description:
What a proportion's denominator counts (SPEC §8.2).

``counts`` is ``known`` (the units of a cohort for which a predicate is known), ``unit_table``
(every unit of the unit table) or ``rows``.
DenominatorDefinition.title: DenominatorDefinition

Derivation.description: What an output was computed from, all of it hashed into its id (SPEC §7.6).
Derivation.title: Derivation

DescriptorShown.description: One descriptor of a release or of the draft, as stored: data (A6).
DescriptorShown.title: DescriptorShown

Disclosure.description: The effective disclosure setting of an output (SPEC §8.4).
Disclosure.title: Disclosure

DisclosureOut.description: The effective disclosure setting: the largest of the floor and the dataset's (§8.4).
DisclosureOut.title: DisclosureOut

DocumentValidation.description:
What ``validate_document`` gives (§8.6, §11.1): every refusal, sorted, and every cohort
that canonicalised.
DocumentValidation.title: DocumentValidation

Empty.description: A body with nothing to say: ``{}``.
Empty.title: Empty

EraseRequest.description: An erasure (D223, D269): the person's key in ``table``, its values in the key's order.
EraseRequest.title: EraseRequest

ErasedOut.description: An erasure done (D223): no key, only what was withdrawn and counted.
ErasedOut.title: ErasedOut

ExclusionReason.description: Why an analysis left out a unit or row (SPEC §6.6): the reasons, and two more.
ExclusionReason.title: ExclusionReason

ExistsLeaf.description: An existence question (SPEC §6.5); ``where`` clauses are ANDed per row of ``table``.
ExistsLeaf.title: ExistsLeaf

FieldsOut.description:
An analysis descriptor's ``fields``, as an output (§9.1). ``params`` and ``returns`` are
JSON Schemas a pack or the core wrote: data, never instructions (A6).
FieldsOut.title: FieldsOut

IdsLeaf.description: An explicit list of unit keys; not allowed inside any ``where`` (SPEC §7.2).
IdsLeaf.title: IdsLeaf

ImportRequest.description:
An import or a re-import (D266). ``original_name`` is an upload's file name, which names
the dataset and its tables (D226); ``pack`` names the pack whose importer reads the source,
never a named connection's (D305). The limits are the server's, never a request's (D253).
ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest

Interval.description: A confidence interval. ``method`` names the method as the analysis entry does (§9.1).
Interval.title: Interval

Issuance.description:
One time an output was produced. ``values_from`` names the issuance whose SQL produced
the values: this one, or for a cache hit the one that filled the cache.
Issuance.title: Issuance

IssuanceRecord.description:
What ``explain`` gives of an issuance: never the request, the document as written and
the parameters, which may hold another client's other cohorts, notes and names, and which
the operator router alone serves (D302).
IssuanceRecord.title: IssuanceRecord

IssuanceRequest.description:
An issuance of the derivation log, by its id, which the body carries so that no URL,
and so no access log, holds it (D302).
IssuanceRequest.title: IssuanceRequest

Limit.description: The limit a refusal hit: one of the names in ``aibi.core.schema.limits``, or a pack's.
Limit.title: Limit

ListAnalyses.description:
``list_analyses``' request (§11.1, D316): every analysis, and with ``dataset`` its
applicability to a release of it, for ``unit`` or, with none, for its keyed tables.
ListAnalyses.title: ListAnalyses

LoggedIssuance.description:
One issuance as the log holds it, its request included: the document as written and the
parameters used, which ``explain`` never gives (D302). Everything from a document is data
(A6).
LoggedIssuance.title: LoggedIssuance

OpenSession.description: A dataset's open curation session, without its handle.
OpenSession.title: OpenSession

PackLeaf.description: A pack leaf, ``<pack id>.<name>``: other members are checked by the pack's schema.
PackLeaf.title: PackLeaf

ParameterReference.description: A parameter reference, "$name", or a literal string written "$$…"

Parameters.description:
The parameters the document used, echoed (outside every digest), and those it declared
but did not use (§7.1).
Parameters.title: Parameters

PathSource.description: An absolute path on the server, inside the upload area or an import directory (D232).
PathSource.title: PathSource

Population.description:
A cohort's accounting over the unit table (SPEC §6.6).

A count is ``null`` only when the disclosure settings suppressed it, and ``suppressed``
lists exactly those members. A breakdown is ``null`` with its total.
Population.title: Population

ProposalsRejected.description:
What a rejection of a proposer's open proposals did: those rejected, and those kept
because the open draft accepted and holds them (D277).
ProposalsRejected.title: ProposalsRejected

ProposeDescriptor.description: A proposal (D248) for a dataset's latest published release, by the agent named.
ProposeDescriptor.title: ProposeDescriptor

PruneRequest.title: PruneRequest

Pruned.description:
What a pruning of the derivation log did (§12.2, D300, D318): the issuances it removed,
the time before which it removed those of counts (``before``) and those of results
(``results_before``), each absent when they are kept until an operator prunes, and the
bytes the log holds now (``log_bytes``).
Pruned.title: Pruned

PutDescriptor.description: Write a whole descriptor, without ``version`` or ``curation``.
PutDescriptor.title: PutDescriptor

QueueField.description: A curated field whose status is ``imported_default`` or ``proposed``.
QueueField.title: QueueField

QueueNote.description:
A note of the import report (D231): counts and row references, never cell values.

The ``curation_queue`` tool gives each count its reference, and a count the disclosure
settings suppress is ``null``, its reason in ``not_estimable``, and lists no rows (D277); the
operator's queue gives the counts as they are, without references.
QueueNote.title: QueueNote

QueueOut.description:
The curation queue as a tool gives it: disclosed, every count with its reference
(D277).
QueueOut.title: QueueOut

QueueUndeclared.description:
A field nobody declared: a table's ``role``, ``primary_key`` or ``grain``, a column's
``datatype``, the ``units`` of a number or time offset, a coverage's ``parents``, or a
relationship without coverage (the coverage's id, at the pointer ``""``).
QueueUndeclared.title: QueueUndeclared

Reason.description: Why a truth value is UNKNOWN (SPEC §6.3). An UNKNOWN always has at least one.
Reason.title: Reason

Refusal.description:
A structured error (SPEC §8.6).

``path`` is a JSON Pointer into the document as written, or ``None``.
Refusal.title: Refusal

RefusalCode.description: Stable refusal codes of the core. Pack codes are namespaced and not listed here.
RefusalCode.title: RefusalCode

Refusals.description: Every error response over HTTP (§8.6, D265).
Refusals.title: Refusals

RejectProposals.description:
A rejection of every open proposal of one ``proposer``, or of every proposer of a
``kind``: exactly one of the two (D277).
RejectProposals.title: RejectProposals

ReleaseRef.description: A release an output drew on. The label is recorded beside the manifest, never hashed.
ReleaseRef.title: ReleaseRef

RemoveDescriptor.description: Remove a relationship, coverage, endpoint or derived column (D245).
RemoveDescriptor.title: RemoveDescriptor

RemoveField.description: Remove a curated field; one with an inference leaves a tombstone (D240).
RemoveField.title: RemoveField

RequirementOut.description:
What an analysis needs, as ``list_analyses`` lists it (§9.1): a descriptor's
``Requirement`` as an output. A pack's text, so data (A6).
RequirementOut.title: RequirementOut

document.description: An analysis document as written, "$name" parameter references allowed (SPEC §7.1)
document.title: Document

SearchCatalog.description: Every filter given must hold; none given lists every dataset (D274).
SearchCatalog.title: SearchCatalog

SessionChange.description: A change to the draft (D245), with the session's handle and the draft it expects.
SessionChange.title: SessionChange

SessionEnd.description: A publish or a discard, with the session's handle and the draft it expects.
SessionEnd.title: SessionEnd

SessionOpened.description: A session opened or taken over: its handle, returned this once (D244, D267).
SessionOpened.title: SessionOpened

SetField.description: Set a curated field's value; its entry becomes ``asserted`` by the operator.
SetField.title: SetField

SkippedProposal.description:
A pack's proposal that was not recorded, or a proposer that failed (no ``descriptor``),
with the codes of why (D249). A name is the pack's text, which is data, or, where the core
does not show what the pack gave, the core's own words as a segment of its own
(``TextSegment``), which no name a pack gives can be (D403).
SkippedProposal.title: SkippedProposal

Source.description:
The document as written, the leaves it maps to and the parameters used; outside every
digest, and data as a whole (A6).
Source.title: Source

StatCount.description: A catalogue statistic's count: ``null`` when suppressed (§8.4), with its reference.
StatCount.title: StatCount

StatValue.description: A value a statistic reports (a smallest or largest value), with its reference.
StatValue.title: StatValue

SubstitutedCohort.description: A cohort. Duplicate datasets are refused by the document checks, with their paths.
SubstitutedCohort.title: Cohort

SubstitutedCohortLeaf.description: Another cohort of the same document (SPEC §7.2).
SubstitutedCohortLeaf.title: CohortLeaf

SubstitutedExistsLeaf.description: An existence question (SPEC §6.5); ``where`` clauses are ANDed per row of ``table``.
SubstitutedExistsLeaf.title: ExistsLeaf

SubstitutedIdsLeaf.description: An explicit list of unit keys; not allowed inside any ``where`` (SPEC §7.2).
SubstitutedIdsLeaf.title: IdsLeaf

SubstitutedPackLeaf.description: A pack leaf, ``<pack id>.<name>``: other members are checked by the pack's schema.
SubstitutedPackLeaf.title: PackLeaf

SubstitutedValueLeaf.description: A value predicate (SPEC §6.4): exactly one of ``values``, ``range`` or ``op`` + ``value``.
SubstitutedValueLeaf.title: ValueLeaf

SubstitutedView.description: A view. Its cohorts and reference are checked by the document checks, with their paths.
SubstitutedView.title: View

TableGraph.description: The tables other than coverage tables, and the relationships between them (§6.1).
TableGraph.title: TableGraph

TakeOver.description:
A take-over, with the open session and the draft it was shown (``GET …/datasets/{d}``),
compared under the session's slot (D415): both, which a browser's request must give, or
neither, which only a client that is not a browser, such as the operator CLI, may.
TakeOver.title: TakeOver

TranslationNote.description: A place where a translation changed meaning or could not be exact (§7.1, D303).
TranslationNote.title: TranslationNote

UploadSource.description: An upload of the same dataset, by its name in the upload area (D234).
UploadSource.title: UploadSource

ValueLeaf.description: A value predicate (SPEC §6.4): exactly one of ``values``, ``range`` or ``op`` + ``value``.
ValueLeaf.title: ValueLeaf

Values.description:
Analysis values: per position in view order, and for the view as a whole.

Their shape is the analysis entry's ``returns``, which the analysis checks when it makes
them (D319); here the whole of it is data (A6), and only its ``not_estimable`` maps are
checked.
Values.title: Values

View.description: A view. Its cohorts and reference are checked by the document checks, with their paths.
View.title: View

ViewCheck.description:
A view that checked against its analysis (§7.4, §7.6, D317): its canonical form, its ids
as the log knows them, its readback and the caveats of its result that need no data.
ViewCheck.title: ViewCheck

curator.description: The curator token (D261), on the operator router alone
